voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Jack - Deep Dark Horror Narrator (BVPhWQykET1TSvfGzrUr), English, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.45 s, atempo 1.0

lines.text: This fire door is locked. Watch it.
lines.beat_before: hook: camera 4 full screen, the closed fire doors, a slow digital zoom

lines.text: Hampton Court Palace, England. October, two thousand three. Three days running, the same fire doors flew open by themselves.
lines.beat_before: the doors burst open; cut to the guard walking the gallery with a torch

lines.text: Each time, a guard came to shut them.
On the second day, the security camera caught something else.
lines.beat_before: he reaches the doors and pushes them shut; cut to the four-camera wall

lines.text: A figure in a long robe, with a pale face, stepped out of the doorway, and pulled the doors shut.
lines.beat_before: camera 4 full screen: the doors burst open again; something in the doorway

lines.text: The palace released the footage. It has never explained it.
lines.beat_before: the robed figure steps out, pulls the doors shut, and is gone

lines.text: Skeptics say it was a visitor in costume. Or a prank.
lines.beat_before: the guard hurries back down the gallery; the doors are shut; silence
the camera wall: on camera 3, far behind the guard, a figure (almost missed)
the wall again: on camera 3 the figure is closer
